title: Iterated bribery sets
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$. Define a sequence of coordinate sets by $J_0=\varnothing$. Given $J_t$, form the function obtained by setting every coordinate in $J_t$ to $1$ before evaluating $f$. If its uniform mean on $\{−1,1\}^n$ is less than $99/100$, let $J_{t+1}$ be $J_t$ together with a coordinate of maximum influence for that modified function; otherwise let $J_{t+1}=J_t$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
